test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A man covers distances of 1980 km, 1306 km, and 540 km at the speed of 12 km/hr, x km/hr, and 36 km/hr, respectively. If his average speed for the whole journey is 14 km/hr, then what is the value of x?
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Total Distance** = 1980 + 1306 + 540 = 3826 km

**Total Time** = Total Distance ÷ Average Speed = 3826 ÷ 14 = 273.285... hours

**Individual Times**: T₁ = 1980 ÷ 12 = 165 hours, T₃ = 540 ÷ 36 = 15 hours

**Time for middle part** = 273.285 − (165 + 15) = 93.285... hours

**Speed x** = 1306 ÷ 93.285... = 14 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 14 km/hr.**

**__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e34b91395765bc6d899f90fb18709f9a482af5d75c29d51812d1d8b6547fa83e.png] 

**Given:** D₁ = 1980, S₁ = 12; D₂ = 1306, S₂ = x; D₃ = 540, S₃ = 36; Avg S = 14

**Formula Used:** Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

⇒ Total Distance = 1980 + 1306 + 540 = 3826 km

⇒ Total Time = (1980 ÷ 12) + (1306 ÷ x) + (540 ÷ 36)

⇒ Total Time = 165 + (1306 ÷ x) + 15 = 180 + (1306 ÷ x)

⇒ 14 = 3826 ÷ [180 + (1306 ÷ x)]

⇒ 180 + (1306 ÷ x) = 3826 ÷ 14

⇒ 180 + (1306 ÷ x) = 273.2857...

⇒ 1306 ÷ x = 273.2857 − 180 = 93.2857

⇒ x = 1306 ÷ 93.2857 = 14

**∴ The correct answer is 14 km/hr.**

**__Additional Information__**

Average Speed Formula

When distances and speeds vary, Average Speed = (Total Distance) ÷ (Total Time). Never average the speeds directly.

Special Case: Equal Distances

If two equal distances are covered at speeds u and v, Average Speed = (2 × u × v) ÷ (u + v).

Conversion Factor

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.</p
